properties.description: The largest cave chamber. A central fire burns low, surrounded by stones, crude tables, bones, and hanging meat. This is where the tribe eats, argues, and listens to the chief.
properties.human_description: A large cave chamber dominated by a central fire. Crude tables, bones, and hanging meat suggest a communal living space.
properties.goblin_description: Kob-Kamp. Center of everything. Fire, food, arguments, meetings. Best place to see and be seen.
